fieldguide.supplementaries.clock_block.d:
ID: T-001
Class: Tool

Known information:
It will only use its power of time travel with a living participant, drawing from their current energy pools to do so. 

If Blood on the Clocktower is used on an empty stomach, it will draw directly from the user's soul energy, causing time related distortions.
fieldguide.supplementaries.clock_block.h: Let the clock get a taste
fieldguide.whimsy_deco.red_phone.descrip:
ID: T-002
Class: Tool

Known information:
The voice behind the phone is colloquially known as 'the tongue of the devil'. Making a request of it seems to whip up random abnormalities in the facility into a frenzy.
fieldguide.whimsy_deco.horseshoe.descrip:
ID: T-003
Class: Tool

Known information:
Widely regarded as a safe abnormality, Horsehoe Theory resonates with nearby containment units, allowing the user to see the stats of them remotely.
fieldguide.whimsy_deco.horseshoe.hint: Place in front of a Containment Unit
fieldguide.whimsy_deco.gatcha_machine.de:
ID: T-004
Class: Tool

Known information:
The earliest user of the Gotchya Machine was driven to believe she was a soldier in the british infantry during the 18th century.
It seems to draw in unknowing users with the promise of toys, occasionally causing psychic distortions that disrupt abnormalities.
fieldguide.abyssal_decor.bottomless_bag_:
ID: T-005
Class: Tool

Known information:
Careful usage of NIRVANA is advised, as spilling the bag may result in entombment. When handled carefully, an entirely safe abnormality.
fieldguide.minecraft.enchanting_table.de:
ID: T-006
Class: Tool

Known information:
It is not known if 'Eraserhead' is the being inside the table, or the table itself. Regardless, it seems to have a disdain for greed, chopping off the head of the user if it gives an enchantment that the user already has on the item it offers.
fieldguide.companions.frog_bonanza_block:
ID: T-007
Class: Tool

Known information:
Gambledeath is a roguelike machine of froglike origin that can be fed coins. It seems to be malevolent, heavily punishing users with 'permadeath' if their luck fails.
fieldguide.scp.deaths_dynamic_shroud.des:
ID: T-008
Class: Tool

Known information:
A farmer's tool that seems to magically rip apart organic matter from abnormalities. Doing so increases its Qliphoth Counter by 1.
fieldguide.scp.rubber_duck.description:
ID: T-009
Class: Tool

Known information:
Promises of endless fortune are fortold by the Rubber Duck.
 The gold it drops seems to be at the expense of living abnormalities.
fieldguide.scp.spoon_bender.description:
ID: T-010
Class: Tool

Known information:
Spoon Benders are incredibly fast, presenting as simple garden gnomes. They seem to love small objects left around, instantly grabbing items no matter where they are located.

 Enjoys messing around with the internals of containment units, occasionally damaging them.
fieldguide.scguns.the_pact.description:
ID: T-011
Class: Tool

Known information:
Not much is known about where the merchant that is summoned from Devil Deeds Done Dirt Cheap, or what happens to the abnormality when it is summoned. No adverse affects have been observed from usage in the last 45 years.
fieldguide.netherman.maze_door.descripti:
ID: T-012
Class: Tool

Known information:
When Slitherman was activated, a martyr for an unknown entity was summon from the gates of Slitherman's soul. After some study, this martyr was found to be harmless, so long as it was kept alive by facility management. Containment procedures require Slitherman's Martyr remain alive so long as there are abnormalities in the facility.
fieldguide.whimsy_deco.lucky_cat.descrip:
ID: T-045
Class: Tool

Known information:
With enough nutrients, the Unlucky Cat seems to have transformed into a completely different abnormality. Dull to the taste of flesh and bone, Fortunate Son craves only Enkephalin, outcompeting the Moonlit Company on price. It is mandated that facility managers dispose of Fortunate Son instead of giving it valuable Enkephalin, cutting into production metrics. When Fortunate Son is satiated, it turns back into Unlucky Cat, causing abnormalities to be driven into a frenzy...
fieldguide.whimsy_deco.singing_frog.desc:
ID: T-014
Class: Tool

Known information:
Normal containment procedures render the Jamming Frog as beneficial for facility management, as placing it down immediately fills the manager with wisdom. Unfortunately, this is a single use operation as the frog seems to lock itself in stasis until activated. UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES SHOULD A FACILITY MANAGER EVER ACTIVATE THE JAMMING FROG.
fieldguide.companions.empty_puppet_block:
ID: T-015
Class: Tool

Known information:
Not yet implemented
fieldguide.companions.croissant_egg_bloc:
ID: T-016
Class: Tool

Known information:
Not yet implemented
fieldguide.companions.soul_furnace_block:
ID: T-017
Class: Tool

Known information:
Not yet implemented
fieldguide.abyssal_decor.black_mold.desc:
ID: T-018
Class: Tool

Known information:
The Moonlit Company has yet to determine if 'Wash My Hands' has originated from this planet or another. It seems to be a conglomarate of living beings that rot solid materials into deepslate, and spreads onto softer materials such as dirt.

Careful containment is required to prevent the swallowing up of all soil on earth by this abnormality.
fieldguide.companions.respawn_totem_bloc:
ID: T-020
Class: Tool

Known information:
Not yet implemented
ID: T-025
Class: Tool

Known information:
The Pot of Greed is simple in its desire for money, and thus it is not dangerous.
fieldguide.companions.holy_porcelain_pot:
ID: T-030
Class: Tool

Known information:
Once thought to be a simple decoration, the Pot of Lust is an incredibly useful tool abnormality that can contain abnormalities inside of it. It has no known adverse effects
fieldguide.csr.clay_soldier.description:
ID: T-131
Class: Tool

Known information:
Sentient mounds of clay can be found in an abnormal room of the facility. They appear to have a violent hatred of Clay Soldiers of a different color, though otherwise are safe to keep around.

When a Clay Soldier picks up a Gold Inogt or Diamond, it will become the leader of the color. Gifting the leader a Clay Cookie will ally the team with the manager.

The Moonlit Company authorizes the usage of allied soldiers throughout the facility.
- Assign a soldier to a Hamster Wheel using POI mode by left clicking the wheel and right clicking the Soldier (Currently bugged to only work in creaitve mode. Sorry!). Redstone Dust can be used on the wheel to turn it into a power generator.
- Crop harvesting & planting, item pickup, and digging jobs can be assigned using POI and work mode.m- Abnormality suprression using T-131 is possible but not advised due to the weakness of the abnormality.
fieldguide.whimsy_deco.moroccan_sofa.des:
ID: R-002
Class: Room

Known information:
The inside of the Living Womb past its Sacred Veil is warm and inviting, causing those inside to not want to escape. A strange cassette plays on its tv, and the outer shell of the room is a solid wall of bone. Any personnel inside of the Living Womb may find themselves to peacefully pass, as the womb births fresh furniture in its place.
fieldguide.echoes.portal.description:
ID: R-003
Class: Room

Known information:
R-003 was created due to the improper use of T-001's time distorting properties by the Starlit Company. It contains nominial levels of Sculk infestation, but most importantly a Timeless Portal that takes personnel who enter it into a parallel dimension. Curiously, only items designated with the 'timeless' attribute can be taken out of the dimension, which is otherwise an encapsulated area.
fieldguide.scguns.sulfur_vent.descriptio:
ID: R-005
Class: Room

Known information:
Like R-006, the intern assigned to room transportation in the Moonlit Company seems to have mistaken a natural wonder of the world for an Abnormality. Given the fact that abnormalities can not become re-classified as normal, the Moonlit Company advises managers to make use of this room Vent Collectors for Sulfur.
fieldguide.scguns.geothermal_vent.descri:
ID: R-006
Class: Room

Known information:
Like R-005, the intern assigned to room transportation in the Moonlit Company seems to have mistaken a natural wonder of the world for an Abnormality. Given the fact that abnormalities can not become re-classified as normal, the Moonlit Company advises managers to make use of this room Vent Collectors for Niter.
fieldguide.supplementaries.safe.descript:
ID: R-009
Class: Room

Known information:
The Starlit Company constructed the shelter at the request of the Moonlit Company after Incident 00593411 with the intent of creating the 'safest place on earth'. It has everything a human needs to survive, filling inhabitants with nutrients and life while they exist in the shelter. After the forced divestment of the two companies, the shelter seems to have corrupted from the broken will of the Starlit Company, causing chaos in the facility it was placed in. After investigation, it was found that shelter was perfectly functional for its intended purpose, but its definition of the 'safest place on earth' had shifted. If it was not the safest place, it would surely become it.
fieldguide.minecraft.chiseled_tuff_brick:
ID: R-131
Class: Room

Known information:
There is nothing particularly interesting or abnormal about the Castle in the Clay other then the fact that the abnormality T-131 arose from it suddenly during the inhabitants normal play hours. Said inhabitant was found alone in the room after their parents were flagged missing, ripped apart by a rabid group of T-131s commanded by the inhabitant.
fieldguide.abyssal_decor.rough_blood_cor:
ID: R-354
Class: Room

Known information:
R-354 is a small sample from a larger body of water located in an undisclosed location. It consists entirely of human blood, and abnormal beings occasionally will rise from the pool. The Moonlit Company recommends automated suppression of abnormal beings though the use of turrets.
